summary.en: Two weeks ago, Kogoro and Conan meet Takayuki Suguro at Beika Central Hospital. He said to his wife, Sayaka, and his secretary, Tateru, that he have six months left to live. He was glad that he took out a life insurance policy Tateru insisted, even though Takayuki was opposed to it.

victims.name: Takayuki Suguro
victims.causeOfDeath: Loss of blood through a slit wound on the wrist
